steps.note: category-pinned create page. If login expired this lands on the passport wall and the next wait times out — run doudian-login first. The page itself is NEVER driven by UI: it only provides tokens + cookies for the pure-API chain below

the create page fires tproduct requests on boot carrying the page-scoped __token/_lid reused by every API call below. duration>0 (NOT responseEnd — the engine's resource timing does not fill that field) means the page's own requests completed. No entry = login wall or boot wedge; re-run, do NOT wait it out

boot-storm gate: after the page's schema responses land, their processing (JSON parse + schema init + React render) is one long sync block that starves timers AND fetch callbacks for tens of seconds to minutes before self-healing (run lessons: setTimeout(100ms) still null at +120s on one load; a getSchema fetch fired into the storm never settled). The probe's callback stays queued and fires the moment the pump frees
pump alive — async fetches are now reliable. If even this times out the page is hard-wedged: re-run the flow (fresh navigation), do NOT wait it out

args.script: (function(){function tl(){var rs=performance.getEntriesByType('resource'),tok='',lid='';for(var i=rs.length-1;i>=0;i--){var u=rs[i].name;if(/\/product\/tproduct\//.test(u)){var mt=u.match(/__token=([a-f0-9]+)/),ml=u.match(/_lid=(\d+)/);if(mt)tok=mt[1];if(ml)lid=ml[1];if(tok&&lid)break}}if(!tok)throw new Error('no __token in resource timing');return{tok:tok,lid:lid}}function qs(t){return 'appid=1&__token='+t.tok+'&_bid=ffa_goods&_lid='+t.lid+(t.mst?'&msToken='+encodeURIComponent(t.mst):'')}function afetch(path,body,t){return fetch(path+'?'+qs(t),{method:'POST',credentials:'include',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(function(r){return r.text()})}var CAT='{{args.category_leaf_id}}';var t=tl();var ctx={category_id:CAT,biz_identity:'xiaodian',business_code:'xiaodian',capability_codes:['standard_capability'],ability:[],operation_type:'create'};window.__TL=t;window.__CTX=ctx;window.__AF=afetch;window.__CLEAN=null;afetch('/product/tproduct/getSchema',{context:ctx,model:{},category_id:CAT,appid:1,__token:t.tok,_bid:'ffa_goods',_lid:t.lid},t).then(function(x){window.__CLEAN=x},function(e){window.__CLEAN='ERR:'+e.message});return 'gsClean-fired'})()

steps.note: API call 1 — getSchema with EMPTY model (zero-risk shape-contract dry run). Async fetch (NOT sync XHR — the engine's sync path is broken: returns status 0 or blocks the eval forever). Response cached on window.__CLEAN
the fetch settles (response or transport error both set __CLEAN)

args.script: (function(){var t=window.__CLEAN,j;try{j=JSON.parse(t)}catch(e){throw new Error('gsClean unparsed '+String(t).slice(0,150))}if(j.st!==0)throw new Error('gsClean st='+j.st+' head='+String(t).slice(0,160));return 'gsClean ok bytes='+t.length})()

steps.note: st:0 = server accepted the hand-built context — the pure-API door is open. st!==0 here = session/context broken; fail fast before anything else fires

API call 2 — THE trick of this flow: send the business model with PLACEHOLDER spec_value ids (spec_id_0..spec_id_17) through getSchema and the server canonicalizes it: spec ids become spec_id+index (30000_10 -> 3000010), each sku row comes back as a full server-built skeleton, free-text property values get value_id:"" + diy_type:0 (legal: zod wants a string, empty string IS one), brand tags normalized to {}. NEVER hand-assemble these shapes — the two 10013 strikes (组件数据解析失败) were exactly a hand-assembled model: pic as bare string array instead of [{url}], invented spec/sku keys. getSchema is read-only: risks nothing, returns the submit-ready model

args.script: (function(){var D={{args}};var t=window.__CANON,j;try{j=JSON.parse(t)}catch(e){throw new Error('gsCanon unparsed '+String(t).slice(0,150))}if(j.st!==0)throw new Error('gsCanon st='+j.st+' head='+String(t).slice(0,200));var d=j.data||{},m=d.model||{},sp=(m.spec_detail||{}).value||[],kd=(m.sku_detail||{}).value||[],pic=(m.pic||{}).value||[];if(!sp.length||sp[0].spec_values.length!==D.spec_values.length)throw new Error('canon: spec values lost');if(kd.length!==D.skus.length)throw new Error('canon: sku rows lost');if(pic.length!==D.main_images.length)throw new Error('canon: main pics lost');window.__CANONJ=d;return JSON.stringify({bytes:t.length,model_keys:Object.keys(m).length,spec_first:sp[0].spec_values[0].id,spec_last:sp[0].spec_values[sp[0].spec_values.length-1].id,sku0:kd[0].code+'@'+kd[0].price})})()

steps.note: st:0 = the FULL business model passed the same server-side component parser that 10013s on shape violations — offline proof the submit will parse. Asserts spec/sku/pic counts survived canonicalization

args.script: (function(){var d=window.__CANONJ,m=d.model||{},ctx=d.context||{};var ctxClean=Object.assign({},ctx);delete ctxClean.gray_components;var sid=String(ctx.shop_id||'');if(!sid)throw new Error('canon: server context has no shop_id');var body={schema:{model:m,context:ctx},category_id:'{{args.category_leaf_id}}',context:ctxClean,pass_through_extra:{},check_status:1,session:{},_signError:'1'};window.__FINAL_BODY=JSON.stringify(body);window.__MSTOKEN=btoa(btoa(sid));return JSON.stringify({bytes:window.__FINAL_BODY.length,shop_id:sid,model_keys:Object.keys(m).length})})()

steps.note: assemble the addWithSchema body from the SERVER's canonicalized model verbatim (shelled — formatSchemaData output shape is shelled: model.goods_category.value) + server-returned context (has shop_id/token/n_token filled in). Body layout per bundle module 51313: {schema, category_id, context(gray stripped), pass_through_extra:{}, check_status:1, session:{}, _signError:'1'} — the frontend itself ships _signError:'1' when genSignatureNew throws, so a missing request_extra signature is not a server gate. msToken = btoa(btoa(shop_id)) computed locally

API call 3 — THE submit. check_status:1 = draft, carried on the QUERY string per bundle module 51313; the full body is the assembled {schema,...} payload. check_status:2 would be the live publish — that path hits the 10001010A risk wall which waits on a real msToken; draft path proven open. ONE SHOT ONLY: 45s abort, timeout = outcome UNKNOWN (the request may still land server-side), never blind-retry — testpack rule
receipt or abort — both leave __SHOT set

receipt: {st:0, product_id} = draft landed (proven 2026-10-05: product_id 3846431717594366336, read-back matched 18 spec/18 sku/5 pics). st!==0 with log_id = a server verdict — record it, do NOT retry. A server rejection is a legitimate flow result; the flow only fails on transport/shape errors. Final publish (draft -> on-sale) is the owner's call from the fxg draft box, per the testpack rule: 素材交接不是无条件上架授权
